/**
 * @name Unsafe symlink handling in file operations
 * @description File operations that follow symlinks without validation can lead to symlink attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-symlink-handling
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-059
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Check for os.open without O_NOFOLLOW flag
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
    // Check for pathlib operations
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() or
    // Check for file operations
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may follow symlinks without proper validation."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe symlink handling in file operations that could lead to symlink attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Time-of-check-time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition
 * @description Checking file properties followed by file operations creates race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/toctou-race-condition
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode check, DataFlow::CallCfgNode use
where
  // File existence checks
  (
    check = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    check = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "is_dir"]).getACall()
  ) and
  // Followed by file operations
  (
    use = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    use = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "makedirs"]).getACall() or
    use = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["open", "unlink", "rmdir", "mkdir"]).getACall()
  )
select check, "File check operation that may lead to TOCTOU race condition if followed by file operation."
findings.hypothesis: Time-of-check-time-of-use (TOCTOU) race conditions where file existence or properties are checked before use

message.text: File check operation that may lead to TOCTOU race condition if followed by file operation.

    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or

    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("makedirs").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()

  exists(call.getArg(1)) // has mode/flags argument
